items.question: How much notice of non-renewal must be given under the MSA?
items.answer:
Under the Harrowgate MSA, if a party wishes to non-renew the agreement, they must provide written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term [1].

Additionally, either party may terminate the Agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice [2].

There is no mention of a different notice period for non-renewal in other clauses, so the primary requirement for non-renewal is ninety (90) days.

evidence.quote: written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term
